notes: Draft rules for task A7/D2 (alerts). Thresholds are first guesses, NOT tuned on recordings.

sound_label rules read the hub sound labeler (hub/separate/models.py SoundLabeler on MIT/ast-finetuned-audioset-10-10-0.4593): per separated stream and per 1 s hop it gives coarse scores (alarm, siren, speech, music, other = max probability over the AudioSet classes mapped by COARSE) and the 527 fine class probabilities. live.py smooths scores with label_smooth=0.6 (new = 0.6 old + 0.4 now), so a sudden alarm needs about two hops to reach 0.5 or more.
'labels' are coarse labels, 'classes' are exact AudioSet display names (checked against the id2label of the checkpoint above). Either matches; the rule score at a time is the highest matching score.

keyword rules need speech text with times. Nothing in the repo transcribes speech yet; the Gemma audio path or another recognizer must supply it. 'keywords' is empty on purpose: put the wearer's name (and spellings the recognizer may produce) here, or pass --name to eval/alerts_check.py.

min_duration_s counts from the first active hop to the end of the last active hop (hop_s each); max_gap_s is the longest silence between active hops that still counts as one event; cooldown_s is the quiet time after a fire during which the same rule cannot fire again.
Output shape follows protocol.AlertFired (alert_id, label, critical, spoken_text, bearing_deg).
